name: agent-creator
description: Build a complete LLM agent from one sentence, or design and debug any part of one. 16 module references with 946 machine-verified file:line citations from two production codebases (Articraft, Claude Code), plus a working stdlib-only agent core: tool contract, dispatch gauntlet, permission ladder, hooks, provider seam, prompt build matrix, run lifecycle, 12 tools, skill acquisition from the open registry, and a preflight that resolves model IDs against the live catalogue.
